notes: COUNT: grep over styles.css lines 2241-3369 finds 194 color literals (hex + rgb/rgba; no hsl) on 140 lines; this file has 194 entries, one per literal, validated line by line. Named colors in range: only 'transparent' (excluded as instructed); the other named-color regex hits are 'white-space' or words inside comments.

ALREADY THEMABLE: the range also carries 205 var() color references (var(--amber) x57, --rr-navy x21, --maple x17, --ink x15, --chalk x15, --rr-c x11, --chalk-dim x10, --rr-navy2 x8, --maple-line x8, --tunnel-2 x6, --rr-scar-deep x6, --rr-pink x6, --whistle x5, --tunnel x5, --rr-sun x4, --rr-blue x4, --rr-scar x3, --rr-green x2, --rr-rule x1, --ok x1). Those follow the :root / .rr tokens and need no literal work.

RISO TOKENS: .rr (L3161-3166) declares 12 --rr-* inks. Map these to theme roles and most of the results page follows. BUT the ballot sheet/toast/tags (.bt-*, appended to body outside .rr, L3234-3362) hard-code the same inks instead of using them: #232A4E, #F4ECDD, #FFB511, #C7870A, #F65058, #B8323B, #B42A36, #8A5D00, #0078BF, #FF48B0, #5B5E73, #4A4E66. --rr-sun-edge, --rr-sun-deep and --rr-scar-edge are declared but never referenced in styles.css. Suggest lifting the --rr-* set to :root (or to a shared .riso scope) so .bt-* and .reel-overlay.riso can use them.

RISO REEL (.reel-overlay.riso, L3123-3149) also hard-codes its inks, with near-duplicates of the .rr palette: scarlet edge/deep #C92F3B and #D63A45 (vs #B8323B / #B42A36), pinks #C8217A, #D6208A, #E0348E (vs #FF48B0), sunflower edge #E0981A (vs #C7870A), plus a tan paper edge #CFC2A6. Consolidation candidates when tokenizing.

AMBER ALPHAS: rgba(255,181,46,a) = exact --amber at 9 different alphas (.32 .35 .4 .45 .5 .55 .6 .78 .95). Near-ambers that are NOT --amber: rgba(230,179,61,a) = #E6B33D (link underlines only, 3 uses), rgba(232,154,28,.24) = spin-face #E89A1C (gate-target rule), rgba(255,214,131,.95) = #FFD683 (two focus rings), #FFD98A (skip-chip text), rgba(21,13,3,.82) = #150D03 (skip-chip fill, a deeper spin-ink), rgba(42,26,5,a) = spin-ink #2A1A05 (rules-button icon well).

REDS/ORANGES ON DARK: #FF8A77 (spend flash, 3 uses), #FFA043 (bank-mid caution, 2 uses), rgba(224,82,60,a) (bank-low outlines: close to but not equal to --whistle #E2654E = 226,101,78), #7e2a24 + #a33a32 (loss squares on the dark reel; the edge is LIGHTER than the fill). #FFA043 is a distinct caution tier with no role; classified bad, but a 'warn' role would keep bank-mid and bank-low distinguishable under a theme.
GREENS: .mpb-delta.pos uses var(--ok) #8FB99B while .bank-up uses literal #7AE08D in the same widget: two different 'good' greens for the same refund event.
SCRIMS: three different overlay bases: rgba(6,8,11,.87) rules sheet, rgba(10,12,16,.94) season reel, rgba(9,11,18,.58) ballot backdrop. All classified overlay.

NAVY ALPHA SPLIT: rgb(35,42,78) = ink. Classified line-paper when it draws a line (borders, dashed outlines, underlines, SVG rail stroke, rings, the grab handle) and ink when it is an alpha wash fill (.bt-tag.add pressed 8%, .rr .tw-track 12%), because a theme's line-paper color at 8% would vanish.

SPECIFICITY BUG (affects what these colors actually paint): decorate3dButtons (app.js L729-750, MutationObserver on the whole document) adds .presti-spin to every <button> not in BTN3D_EXCLUDE. button.presti-spin is (0,1,1) and sets background, border:0, color and box-shadow, so it beats single-class rules (0,1,0). Buttons in this range whose authored skin is therefore overridden: .hh-charity (authored transparent ghost, 60% amber outline, chalk text: renders as an amber keycap), .reel-skip (authored transparent ghost with maple-line border: amber keycap), dark-reel .reel-done (amber slab with maple shadow: presti gradient instead). .reel-overlay.riso .reel-skip (0,3,0) sets only color and border-color, so on paper it is navy text on the amber presti gradient with a zero-width border. Same class of bug as the documented .hh-skip fix. Deduced from the cascade, not checked in a browser. Fix: add these classes to BTN3D_EXCLUDE or raise specificity.
DEAD VALUE: .bt-tag.add box-shadow inset rgba(35,42,78,0.5) at L3259 is overridden by the next rule at L3262 (box-shadow: none; dashed border).

NOT REACHABLE FROM CSS (JS/canvas/SVG in this range's components): (1) reel-riso.js: calendar strips (.riso-strip) and effects (.riso-fx) are canvases inked from INKS rgb arrays sun [255,181,17], pink [255,72,176], scarlet [246,80,88] (L49-52), and the effects text uses inkPattern(scarlet); the reel card's paper texture is a canvas data URL set as card.style.backgroundImage (L256) drawn with #F4ECDD, #8b7f68, #776c5a, #ffffff. (2) results-riso.js: the hero print (.rr-print-canvas) uses INKS sun, pink, blue [0,120,191], teal [0,131,138], orange [255,108,47] (L82-86) plus PAPER #F4ECDD (L52) and the same paper-grain colors (L140, L147); app.js L6256 sets --rr-paper on :root to T82PRINT.paper() (a cream texture image), so slips keep a cream texture whatever --rr-c is. (3) app.js bookIconSvg (the HOW TO PLAY icon) hard-codes fill #2A1A05 and #FFF3D6; hoopMarkSvg (.du-brand) hard-codes #2A1A05 and #FFF3D6 next to var(--amber)/var(--maple). (4) app.js L2887 glove (.bt-hand) SVG hard-codes fill #FFFFFF and stroke #232A4E. (5) .mpb-fill width is set inline from JS (width only, no color); bank state colors come from classes (tickBank) and ARE reachable from CSS.

FAMILY CALLS: the reel's structural pieces are family overlay on the dark reel and print on the riso reel; text and buttons inside both are classed by element type (eyebrow, data, heading, button-*). .sk-chip and .cap-cost are classed badge (small non-interactive labels), not chip. The shared focus ring list at L3329 is filed under button-primary although it also covers tiles, done and change.
